digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures and test harness environment isolation
propositions: Seven pytest fixtures return dict(os.environ) directly or nested, exposing arbitrary ambient credentials when pytest renders fixture arguments in long tracebacks via saferepr.
Decorated fixtures at seven file/line locations copy complete insertion-ordered os.environ into subprocess environment mappings that become test-argument serialization carriers.
Long traceback rendering leaks inherited ambient secrets exactly once per fixture surface, while short traceback and child-invocation replacement do not trigger the leak.
Minimal-environment test runs under env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin pass all 42 affected fixture consumers, proving no arbitrary ambient keys are required for test behavior.

Each fixture's allowlist requires explicit mutable mappings containing only fake-bin-first PATH plus harness-specific declared variables (STATE_DIR/DEPLOY_REPO/COMPOSE_DIR/MIRROR_DIR/HEALTH_TIMEOUT/REPL_LOG as applicable per fixture), excluding unrelated caller credentials.
